req.title: Retrieve player by squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/squadNumber/{squadNumber} with the player wearing that squad number.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} retrieves a player by their squad number. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — a valid squad number that exists returns 200 with correct payload; (2) negative NEG — a squad number that does not exist returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — the lowest squad number in the dataset (1) and one below it (0) to catch off-by-one mutations; (4) boundary BVA — the highest squad number (26) and one above it (27); (5) negative NEG — a non-integer path segment returns 422; (6) DT — verifying all response fields exactly to kill field-mapping and constant mutations; (7) EP — a mid-range squad number with optional fields populated (squad 3, has middleName). Each test uses exact value assertions on status code and response body fields to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_positive_squad10
preconditions: Database contains player with squadNumber=10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
expected: Response body contains all fields matching the seeded row for squad 10
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_positive_squad10():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Mary'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'DM'
    assert body['team'] == 'River Plate'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == False
    assert 'id' in body
    assert body['id'] == 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'
